integrity: The full 2026 primary source was checked for the class definition, exponential image domain, primary MSC, and canonical extremal. The uniform-convexity criterion was compared with classical parabolic-domain formulations. The threshold is proved by an exact logarithmic-boundary minimization with an analytic uniqueness argument; the packaged numerical checker only evaluates the uniquely characterized root.
scientific_limitations: The result gives the exact parameter threshold for ordinary uniform convexity of the exponentially convex Ma–Minda class. It does not classify all k-uniformly convex thresholds, does not claim an elementary closed form for the threshold, and does not modify the growth, distortion, pre-Schwarzian, or Schwarzian estimates of the defining source.
title: Exact uniform-convexity phase boundary for exponentially convex functions
